description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing merchant-related operations in a React-Redux application, including CRUD operations, validation, and navigation.

methods.name: merchantChange
methods.description: Creates an action to update merchant form data with a given field name and value.

methods.name: merchantSignupChange
methods.description: Creates an action to update merchant signup form data with a given field name and value.

methods.name: setMerchantLoading
methods.description: Creates an action to set the loading state for merchant operations.

methods.name: setMerchantSubmitting
methods.description: Creates an action to set the submitting state for merchant operations.

methods.name: addMerchant
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action to validate and submit new merchant data to the API, with optional navigation back.

methods.name: fetchMerchants
methods.description: Fetches a list of merchants from the API with pagination.

methods.name: searchMerchants
methods.description: Searches merchants based on a filter value.

methods.name: disableMerchant
methods.description: Enables or disables a merchant's active status via API call.

methods.name: approveMerchant
methods.description: Approves a merchant via API call.

methods.name: rejectMerchant
methods.description: Rejects a merchant via API call.

methods.name: merchantSignUp
methods.description: Handles merchant sign-up process, including validation, API call, and redirect.

methods.name: deleteMerchant
methods.description: Deletes a merchant via API call and updates the merchant list.
